message: Last week, during a surprise blackout, my friend Sarah started panicking like we were in a scene from a disaster movie. I couldn’t help but chuckle as I pulled out my trusty flashlight and power bank—always handy! I reminded her that a little preparation goes a long way in keeping calm when the lights go out. We set up a cozy spot with snacks and our favorite board game, and soon enough, the darkness felt more like an adventure than a crisis. What’s your go-to tip for staying relaxed during a power outage?  😊
